canva.title: Sleiman Systems – Visual System V1
canva.rule: Use Canva for visual system, covers, UI mockups and reusable layouts. Daily final MP4 is rendered by the internal GitHub renderer so publishing never depends on Canva export or paid AI credits.

explain.rule: Use Explain to prototype process explanations and narration. If no direct MP4 handoff is available, rebuild the winning structure in the internal motion renderer before publishing.

criteria: first frame understood in under one second
target customer or pain immediately clear
hook creates tension via loss, number, contrast, question or surprise
visible motion in first three seconds
proof/demo/value within five to eight seconds

voice_system.rule: Public reels must use the private Ibrahim voice clone. Generic stock TTS is blocked from publishing.

retention_first_rules.objective: Improve 0-3s retention and share/comment behavior before increasing complexity.

first_frame.rule: The pain, surprise, number, or useful promise must be understandable without audio.

opening.rule: No 'Heute zeige ich', no greeting, no context preamble. Start with the strongest sentence.

payoff.rule: Show proof, answer, transformation, or usable takeaway before explanation.

density.rule: Delete explanations that can be inferred visually.

social_native_rules.priority: native founder/handwerk feel over polished corporate ad feel
preferred_mix: real Ibrahim/founder footage or realistic work-context footage
avoid: four similar corporate slides in sequence
visuals that feel like a website presentation

06:45.structure: loss hook -> concrete consequence -> one fix
06:45.rule: Use the exact user-approved voice profile from voice_system.json; regenerate voice, never reuse an older 1.12 legacy file.

10:00.rule: Give the useful artifact on-screen fast enough that a viewer has a reason to save.

13:15.rule: Demonstrate, do not narrate four explanatory slides.

17:00.structure: specific contrarian claim -> reason -> direct question
17:00.rule: The opinion must be concrete enough to agree/disagree with.

20:30.rule: Do not optimize this slot primarily for virality.

viral_candidate_rule: Never call a video viral or a viral candidate from views alone. Require clear platform-relative improvement in retention plus at least one secondary signal such as shares, saves, comments, profile actions, qualified inbound, or unusually strong view velocity.

color_psychology.principle: Color is functional, not decorative. Use one dominant emotional color plus one support color per reel; keep typography and motion consistent enough to preserve brand recognition.
rules: Do not render five consecutive dark-navy reels.
Do not use more than two strong accent colors in one scene.
Use red only when the message contains a real loss/warning, not as decoration.
Use green for visible resolution/result moments.
Use off-white/light scenes as pattern interrupts between dark scenes.
Maintain Sleiman Systems identity through typography, spacing, motion language, and logo treatment rather than one background color.

creator_standard.target: Top-tier niche creator quality for German Handwerk process/AI content.
priorities: show the workflow before naming the product
one memorable visual metaphor per reel
clear benefit to owner/office within 5 seconds
content must work muted and still become stronger with voice
disallow: text-heavy cards with no visual action

first_three_seconds.objective: Earn the next second before explaining anything.
requirements: At least 3 distinct visual or audio beats inside the first 3 seconds.
Use a pattern interrupt in frame 0: real-life message, bold contradiction, alarming status, timer, question, or visually obvious before/after.
No logo intro and no generic brand card before the hook.
At least one moving UI/object, shake, bounce, pop-in, timer, progress, or rapid scene transition — not only zooming a static slide.
The core problem or promised benefit must be understandable muted in <=1 second.
Show the actual workflow/product by second 4 whenever the format is demo/conversion.

meme_and_sfx_rules.use: Original meme-style storytelling and original/synthesized sound effects when they improve attention or comedic timing.
rules: Do not copy copyrighted meme clips or ripped trend audio.
Memes must map to a real Handwerk pain point, not random entertainment.
Sound effects punctuate visual changes; they must not overpower Ibrahim's voice.
Humor is a delivery mechanism, not the entire value proposition.

audio_mastering.voice_priority: Ibrahim voice sits clearly in front of music on phone speakers.
audio_mastering.bed_rule: Music ducks under voice; never force natural speech into a shorter edit just to hit duration.

creative_mix.daily_goal: The five daily pieces should not look like five slides from one template.

kinetic_subtitles.purpose: Subtitles are part of the creative, not accessibility text pasted on top.
rules: Keep each caption beat short: usually 2-5 words, never a paragraph.
Place captions in the vertical safe zone above platform controls.
Highlight one semantic keyword per beat with color psychology.
Use pop-in or bounce timing at phrase changes; captions should visually follow the spoken rhythm.
Loss/warning keywords use red; urgency orange/yellow; AI cyan; clarity/trust blue; result/money/relief green; contrarian/innovation purple.
Do not cover the key demo interaction or CTA.
Every reel must remain understandable when muted.

dual_objective.principle: Every piece of content has a primary reach job and a secondary business job. A high-view clip with no qualified business movement is not automatically a winner.
reach_score_inputs: average watch time and average percentage viewed
view velocity relative to the account baseline
revenue_score_inputs: cash collected attributable to content when verifiable
dual_objective.decision_rule: Promote concepts that improve either reach or revenue without materially damaging the other. Build variants of clips that score high on both.

signature_series.name: 3-Sekunden-Test
signature_series.mechanic: Viewer must answer or notice something before the reveal.
examples: Welches Angebot würdest du zuerst nachfassen?
Findest du den Fehler im Prozess?

signature_series.name: CHEF.EXE
signature_series.mechanic: Original meme-style exaggeration of real owner bottlenecks.
examples: Wenn jeder Rückruf ein Gedächtnistest ist

signature_series.name: Chaos vs System
signature_series.mechanic: Split-screen race or before/after where Sleiman Systems visibly changes the workflow.

signature_series.name: In 7 Sekunden
signature_series.mechanic: Show a complete micro-workflow with a timer and no abstract explanation.

signature_series.name: Unbequeme Wahrheit
signature_series.mechanic: Specific contrarian claim that a Handwerkschef can agree or disagree with.
examples: Mehr Leads können dein Chaos vergrößern
Der Chef darf nicht das Betriebsgedächtnis sein

anti_fatigue: Never use the same first-frame composition twice in one day.
Never use the same dominant color in more than two daily posts.
Rotate light, dark, split-screen, phone simulation, dashboard, founder/UGC footage when available.
At least two daily posts must show a concrete Sleiman Systems workflow, not only talk about problems.

revenue_bridge.rule: Do not hard-sell in every reel. Give the viewer a reason to care first, then bridge naturally to the next step.
cta_rotation: DM keyword only when a real response flow exists
revenue_bridge.offer_visibility: For demo and conversion formats, show what the customer gets before naming the offer.

human_presence.priority: Increase real founder/human presence as soon as clean Ibrahim footage is available.
human_presence.rule: Use real Ibrahim footage for some hooks, reactions, POV intros and CTA moments; combine it with UI/process overlays rather than replacing all content with synthetic visuals.
